scope: Stage 1 public-source enforcement comparison; no installation, keys, signing or broadcast

sources.title: BRC-48 Pay to Push Drop
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Defines dropped data plus owner signature locking.
Explicitly leaves higher-order token rules to overlays.
sources.limits: Specification is not a monetary conservation covenant.

sources.title: SDK PushDrop implementation
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Default lock order is owner P2PK first then dropped data; alternate after position is supported.
Unlock defaults to signing all outputs with anyoneCanPay false.
sources.limits: No amount conservation or issuer allowlist is enforced by this script template.

sources.title: Canonical BTMS topic manager
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Admits ISSUE as fresh txid.vout; transfer allowances come from previousCoins.
Admits individual output prefixes within allowance and exact metadata comparison.
No separate issuer-only retirement rule.
sources.limits: Topic admission, not consensus; the function alone does not validate complete lineage.

sources.limits: Tests were read, not run.

Client metadata recognition differs from topic-manager heuristic.

sources.title: BRC-161 BSV-21 legacy JSON
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Defines fixed-supply and authority models with indexer-enforced token rules.
Recommends new fungible issuance under BRC-162.
sources.limits: Generic token model is not CBDC policy.

sources.title: BRC-162 Mandala
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Indexer-enforced per-token conservation or mint from authority; authority can split/transfer/end.
Base amounts up to 2^64-1; implicit burn permitted; payload is not admission policy.
Its Implementations section says None yet.
sources.limits: That status conflicts with relevant current ts-stack source; no claim all implementations match this version.

sources.title: BRC-176 token validity proofs
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Requires recursively sufficient token-parent transaction bodies for scoped DAG proof.
Excludes unspent membership and global circulating supply.
sources.limits: Base token proof does not prove stricter regulated-overlay policy or current freeze/eviction state.

sources.title: Regulated Mandala topic manager
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Combines generic ledger, ownership, trusted authority and issuer controls.
Requires nonempty canonical trustedIssuers and journals owners before admittance.
sources.limits: Static source only; no production acceptance, legal assurance or deployment qualification.

sources.title: Regulated Mandala implemented contract
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: P2PKH one-satoshi authority/value outputs; off-chain owner-linkage/admin envelope.
Exact holder conservation, issue/redeem/reissue deltas and control rejects.
Caps the regulated profile at 2^53-1.
sources.limits: Implementation profile is stricter than base BRC-162 and relies on configuration and external state.

sources.title: Regulated authority enforcement
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Trusted authority input/output owners; authority continuity and at most one action commitment.
Holder delta zero; issue positive; redeem negative; reissue matches frozen amount and recipient.
Reads indexed supply for positive-delta cap checks.
sources.limits: No independent treasury officer quorum or treasury-only redeem condition identified in these checks; concurrency qualification is pending.

sources.title: Regulated controls enforcement
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Rejects frozen/evicted inputs; pause/access controls; screening and membership.
Authority transactions bypass pause/access only after frozen/evicted checks; sanctions apply to all identities.
sources.limits: Enforced by overlay admission, not the P2PKH consensus script.

sources.title: Regulated admin state reducer
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Reissue removes frozen reference and adds evicted outpoint.
Fee rate is stored as control state.
sources.limits: State fold does not spend the old UTXO or prove fee payment.

sources.title: Regulated supply/index storage
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: circulatingSupply excludes evicted outpoints that remain on chain.
Uses bigint for the sum; row-repair semantics distinguish indexes from owner journal.
sources.limits: Global liability reconciliation and concurrent admission atomicity are not established by reading this file.

sources.title: Regulated lookup and reorg primitives
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Includes live freeze context, admin history, purge/refold and input-row restoration.
Restoration requires the caller to verify the input is again unspent and admitted.
sources.limits: Not evidence that all deployment paths invoke these primitives correctly.

sources.title: Regulated owner linkage
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Checks exact P2PKH shape, one satoshi, safe-integer cap and verified owner linkage.
Owner-index repair depends on owner journal and admitted engine output.
sources.limits: Cryptographic key control does not itself prove lawful holder identity.

sources.title: Generic BRC-162 ledger implementation
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Classifies already-admitted predecessor inputs; builds per-token bigint ledgers.
Base authority/conservation verdicts are separated from regulated checks.
sources.limits: Calling the ledger alone does not confer trusted previousCoins or issuer policy.

sources.title: Overlay engine submission path
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: SPV-verifies normal submissions; obtains previousCoins from unspent topical state.
Any accepted topic can enable broadcast; all-topic rejection suppresses engine broadcast.
Mutation and external broadcast have separate phases.
sources.limits: External broadcaster bypass remains possible; historical no-SPV route requires independent trust. No end-to-end recovery test executed.

sources.title: BRC-22 overlay synchronization
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only
claims: Servers choose topic-specific rules and return admitted outputs and retained history.
Validation pipeline is implementation-defined.
sources.limits: A topic name or acknowledgment alone is not uniform policy, finality or global supply proof.

sources.limits: A technique, not an implemented fungible CBDC.

sources.title: BRC-197 executable revenue-listing covenant
sources.access: Complete file retrieved using GitHub connector; static read only

Listing family has bounded input/output counts and satoshi revenue semantics.

sources.title: BRC-226 resale-royalty covenant proposal
